name: Luscombe 8 Silvaire
summary: Small two-seat all-metal high-wing taildragger from the late 1930s–50s, many still flown in polished aluminum.

engines: Small flat-four in a smooth, close-fitting cowl
fuselage: All-metal monocoque fuselage, often polished bare aluminum
Tailwheel gear with spring/oleo main legs
tail: Tall, rounded fin and rudder on a slim metal tail cone

tellTales: Small all-metal high-wing taildragger, often polished bare aluminum
Side-by-side two-seat cabin with a slim tapering metal tail cone

confusedWith.howToTell: The Champ is fabric-covered with tandem seats; the Luscombe is all-metal with side-by-side seats.
The 150/152 sits on tricycle gear; the Luscombe is a taildragger.
The Citabria is fabric-covered with tandem seats and a squared tail; the Luscombe is all-metal with a rounded tail.
